title: A lot of people say “sorry.”
paragraphs:
A lot of people say “sorry.”
But the Bible calls us to something deeper.

Not just regret.
Not just guilt.
Not just an apology.
Acts 3:19 — “Repent ye therefore, and be converted.”

God isn't looking for perfect people.
But He is looking for hearts willing to turn.

Have you ever apologized…
but kept doing the same thing?
But biblical repentance isn't just saying sorry.
Walking away from what you know is wrong.
Do you think people today talk about forgiveness more than repentance?
